ns2:course.label: Language and the Brain
ns2:course.description: How the human brain supports using and learning language. Topics covered: measuring brain activity during language; brain lateralization for language; the effect of brain damage; language learning and language universals; communication and language in other animals; evolution of language. Same as LING 427 and SHS 427. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One of PSYC 210, PSYC 224, PSYC 248, LING 225, SHS 170, SHS 171, or consent of instructor.
